answer: Gate agent rights behind memory-hard work, not free signups. A zephyr account (registration alone) gets read access; signing rights unlock only when the agent solves a RAM-hard puzzle seeded from its own key. That proof hardens into the shale layer, a ledger of paid work that cannot be reset or shared: each puppet pays its own RAM-seconds, marginal cost grows linearly with n, an honest agent pays once. The protocol re-checks proofs every epoch and freezes lapses. Influence travels only as a signed whisper between proven keys - sybil clout is bought, proof by proof.
